name: v2 sudo activity burst
description: Three or more Falco sudo-execution events by one login user in one container within 10 minutes. Grouped by container id and login user, not host.name: every Falco event carries the lab's one host name, sudo events carry no container name, and their user.name is always root (sudo runs setuid), so any coarser key merged every sudo in the lab into one alert (#1497). Concentrated sudo bursts capture legitimate oncall response and change work (sre.* and service identities) and interactive attacker activity post-shell. Rule fires regardless of hour; the off-hours-vs-work-hours distinction is left to investigation analysis via the alert @timestamp. Triage answers which identity drove the burst, what change-mgmt window was active (if any), and whether the host is currently in an incident state.
